description: This file contains unit tests for the DeepLinksSecurity component of the OpenClaw project. It checks various deep link URLs for security validation, ensuring that insecure configurations are rejected and secure (loopback) configurations are accepted.

classes.name: DeepLinksSecurityTests
classes.description: A test suite containing multiple test cases for deep link security validation in OpenClaw.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that a gateway deep link with a non-loopback host and insecure TLS is rejected.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Tests that a gateway deep link with a bypass host prefix that is insecure is rejected.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkAllowsLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that a gateway deep link with a loopback host is accepted.

methods.name: setupCodeRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that a setup code with an insecure non-loopback WebSocket URL is rejected.

methods.name: setupCodeRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Tests that a setup code with an insecure bypass host is rejected.

methods.name: setupCodeAllowsLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that a setup code with a loopback WebSocket URL is accepted.
